goal: Bounded A24 CG_DC short-load AP model development, freeze and unseen-session confirmation; not a general thermal/online policy model

confirmation_transform.C: zero work; retain four runtimes and eight warmups
confirmation_transform.L50: original registered L35 releases plus 15 seconds, all 24 requests
confirmation_transform.SPLIT_DELAY30: original L35 releases; ordinals 12 through 23 delayed by 30 seconds; arrivals/backend unchanged

data_roles.archived: Already-seen design evidence only; exclude from new fitting and independent confirmation denominators
data_roles.development: Six new background contrast sessions; original frozen readout remains unchanged; separate offline candidate development permitted only after all six are eligible
data_roles.confirmation: Six fresh sessions acquired only after immutable candidate/initializer/support/analysis freeze; never fit or select using these targets

candidate_family.u: original state AP slope minus original resident idle slope; actual lane states only
fixed: no observed current or later AP as inputs
candidate_family.objective: Mean of six per-session mean squared AP residuals; two nonnegative linear load coefficients at each beta; no sample-count weighting of sessions
diagnostics: leave-one-session-out prediction and coefficient spread within this family
0.1C quantization sensitivity, not confidence or certified uncertainty
candidate_family.selection: M0 is existing fixed candidate; M1 is this one family. Freeze M1 only if identified, interior beta and leave-one-session-out MAE, maximum absolute and absolute peak errors are each no worse than M0 in every development condition mean, with at least one strict improvement. Otherwise M0 or stop; never introduce a second family.
candidate_family.control_failure: If either selected-model control predicts a direction strictly opposite to an observed fixed-window endpoint interval using +/-0.05C rounding sensitivity, stop before confirmation. Zero-containing intervals are unresolved, not successful direction identification.
candidate_family.identification_stop: Rank deficient, nonfinite, beta grid endpoint optimum or incompatible eligible control response: do not extend grid, add state, add sessions or fit confirmation. Zero k/g is a reduced model, not evidence that that physical effect is absent. Record unresolved practical identification even when numerical rank is full.

confirmation_scope: Actual-schedule conditional AP on the registered unbroken and split 24-request profiles and measured initial histories only. Not CPU policy, arbitrary arrivals, per-state coefficient identification, ambient/internal temperature, throttling or safety certification.
stop: First execution/environment/quality/data/budget failure stops its block and the study. Freeze failure blocks confirmation. No consumed resume, automatic replacement, new plan or coefficient adaptation after confirmation.
finish: All prespecified confirmation metrics and scope restrictions published, or bounded failed/unidentified conclusion. No thirteenth session. Prediction adequacy, improved relative errors and policy separability are distinct; error publication alone does not enable strict/default.
policy_ranking: No universal error band. At most matched registered scenarios with session-level sensitivity; overlapping differences or unvalidated inputs mean unresolved ranking, not zero cost or winner.
execution_blockers: New-family fitting/LOSO/freeze and control-direction checks must be implemented and tested before collecting development
Separate confirmation planner must bind the frozen candidate, request transformations and prospective prediction inputs; existing six-session runner is not a twelve-session runner
Current device/install/environment gates are unqueried; no device execution approval in this study-design turn
